source.name: Bundled demo corpus (generated tickets)
source.caveat: Synthetic data. The symptom-to-resolution patterns are plausible but invented, and no timing information is carried. Treat a match as a hypothesis worth checking, never as evidence that this estate has seen the problem before.

entries.resolution: Faulty display cable was replaced; monitor detected correctly afterward.
Confirmed available license seat, installed software remotely, and verified activation with the user.
Docking station firmware was outdated; updated firmware and display detection resumed normally.
PBX service had crashed following a scheduled update; restarted service and verified call routing restored.

entries.symptom: Account locked out - password reset request
entries.resolution: Verified user identity per policy, reset password, and unlocked account. User confirmed successful login.
IKE Phase 2 lifetime mismatch between on-prem firewall and cloud gateway caused repeated renegotiation failures; aligned settings on both ends.
License renewal had not been processed before expiry due to a billing delay; renewed license and restarted license server.
Certificate renewed and rotated; also added expiry monitoring alert 30 days out to prevent recurrence.
Print spooler service on the shared print server had hung; restarted spooler service and cleared stuck jobs.

entries.symptom: S3 bucket S3-bucket access denied errors
entries.resolution: Bucket policy had been overwritten by an automation script, removing required cross-account access; restored correct policy from backup.

entries.symptom: S3 bucket S3-bucket access denied errors
entries.resolution: Bucket ACL blocked public access as intended, but application was incorrectly using public URL instead of signed URL; corrected application config.
PBX server had lost connectivity to the SIP trunk provider; provider confirmed and resolved an outage on their end.

entries.symptom: Azure Storage account AzureStorage request throttling
entries.resolution: A batch job was issuing an unusually high volume of small requests; refactored job to batch requests together.
Created AD account, provisioned laptop, and granted access to required systems ahead of start date; confirmed with hiring manager.
License server's activation file was corrupted after a server migration; re-applied activation file from vendor.

entries.symptom: MFA enrollment issue on new device
entries.resolution: Old MFA device registration was still active and conflicting with new enrollment; removed old device and re-enrolled new one.
Printer's static IP conflicted with another device on the network after a DHCP change; corrected IP assignment.

entries.symptom: S3 bucket S3-bucket access denied errors
entries.resolution: IAM role used by the application was missing s3:GetObject permission after a recent policy cleanup; added scoped permission back.
VPN client software was outdated and incompatible with the latest gateway update; upgraded client to current version.

entries.symptom: Azure AD sign-in failures for AzureAD-tenant
entries.resolution: A recently modified Conditional Access policy was requiring MFA from an unsupported legacy client; scoped policy to exclude legacy auth.
Source volume was locked by another process during the backup window; adjusted backup schedule to avoid overlap.
A flaky integration test was intermittently failing the build; quarantined test and opened follow-up ticket for a proper fix.

entries.symptom: Account locked out - password reset request
entries.resolution: Account lockout was caused by an old cached credential on a mobile device; cleared cached credentials and reset password.
Files were also found in the recycle bin, avoiding need for a full restore; recovered directly from there.
Automated renewal via ACME had silently failed due to a DNS validation record issue; corrected DNS record and renewal completed.

entries.symptom: IAM role IAM-role permission error on deployment
entries.resolution: New deployment introduced a call to a service the role had never needed before; added least-privilege policy statement for the new action.
Liveness probe was misconfigured with too short a timeout for the app's startup time; adjusted probe settings.
A background antivirus full scan was consuming most CPU; rescheduled scans to outside working hours.
AP had overheated in an enclosed cabinet; relocated device and added ventilation.

entries.symptom: Azure VM AzureVM OS disk near capacity
entries.resolution: Resized OS disk to next tier and extended the volume within the OS to provide additional headroom.

entries.symptom: Huawei Cloud ECS HW-ECS network unreachable
entries.resolution: Security group rule was inadvertently removed during a cleanup script run; restored required inbound/outbound rules.
Underlying database had an outdated query plan due to stale statistics; refreshed statistics and performance normalized.
Disk was nearly full, causing excessive paging; cleared temp files and freed up space.
Completed onboarding checklist; delayed by pending approval for one system access request, resolved after manager sign-off.
Password had expired per policy; guided user through self-service reset and re-synced mail client.
ISP-side outage on the on-prem circuit caused the tunnel drop; connectivity restored automatically once ISP resolved the issue.

entries.symptom: Azure AD sign-in failures for AzureAD-tenant
entries.resolution: Sign-in failures traced to a transient Azure AD service incident (confirmed via Microsoft Service Health); resolved on Microsoft's side.

entries.symptom: Azure VM AzureVM OS disk near capacity
entries.resolution: Cleared accumulated IIS/application log files older than 30 days and configured log rotation to prevent recurrence.

entries.symptom: IAM role IAM-role permission error on deployment
entries.resolution: Role trust policy was updated incorrectly during a recent security hardening pass; corrected trust relationship.

entries.symptom: IAM role IAM-role permission error on deployment
entries.resolution: A scheduled IAM policy audit had revoked a permission still required by a legacy component; permission restored with justification documented.
New deployment referenced a ConfigMap key that no longer existed after a config refactor; corrected reference and redeployed.
User's home router was blocking the required VPN port; provided guidance to adjust router firewall settings.

entries.symptom: Azure Storage account AzureStorage request throttling
entries.resolution: Enabled a second storage account and sharded traffic across both to distribute request load.
Backup agent lost connectivity mid-job due to a transient network blip; job re-ran successfully on retry.
Located files in the previous night's backup snapshot and restored them to the original location; user confirmed files intact.
Access point had a firmware bug causing periodic drops under high client count; applied vendor firmware update.

entries.symptom: Huawei Cloud ECS HW-ECS network unreachable
entries.resolution: Underlying network interface required a manual reset on the Huawei Cloud console; connectivity restored after reset.
A misbehaving browser extension was consuming excessive memory; removed extension and cleared cache.
File server had run out of available connections under peak load; increased connection limit and restarted service.
Folder-level NTFS permissions had been overwritten by an inheritance change; restored explicit permissions.
Account had been locked out after multiple failed sign-in attempts from a stale mobile device; unlocked account and removed old device.

entries.symptom: Azure VM AzureVM OS disk near capacity
entries.resolution: Windows Update cache had grown unusually large; ran disk cleanup and cleared component store using DISM.
A recent code deployment introduced an inefficient query in a frequently used page; reverted and scheduled a proper fix.
Application server's thread pool was exhausted under load; increased pool size and restarted application service.
One backend instance was silently failing under load; deregistered instance and replaced via auto scaling group.
Team's security group membership had been removed during a recent AD cleanup; re-added group and access restored.
No license seat was available; procured an additional license and completed installation once approved.
Channel overlap between adjacent access points was causing interference; reconfigured channel plan.
Build agent ran out of disk space from accumulated Docker layers; cleared cache and added scheduled cleanup job.

entries.symptom: MFA enrollment issue on new device
entries.resolution: User's device clock was out of sync, causing TOTP codes to fail; corrected device time settings and enrollment succeeded.
User's MFA token had desynced; re-registered device for MFA and connection succeeded.
Backup destination storage had reached its quota; freed space by expiring old backup generations and re-ran job successfully.
On-prem firewall rebooted for a scheduled patch without prior notice; tunnel re-established manually after reboot completed.
Pipeline was failing due to an expired deployment credential stored in the CI secrets manager; rotated credential and re-ran pipeline.
Printer had run out of toner and paused the queue silently; replaced toner cartridge and resumed queue.

entries.symptom: Azure Storage account AzureStorage request throttling
entries.resolution: Storage account was on Standard tier and hitting default request-rate limits; upgraded to Premium tier for the affected workload.

entries.symptom: Huawei Cloud ECS HW-ECS network unreachable
entries.resolution: VPC peering connection had entered a stale state after a route table update; re-established peering and verified connectivity.

entries.symptom: RDS instance RDS-db high CPU / slow queries
entries.resolution: Identified a missing index on a frequently-queried table; added index and query plan improved significantly.
Renewed certificate through the internal CA and deployed to all affected endpoints ahead of expiry.
Mailbox had exceeded its storage quota, silently blocking new sign-ins; archived old mail and restored access.

entries.symptom: Azure AD sign-in failures for AzureAD-tenant
entries.resolution: Users were affected by an expired federation certificate between Azure AD and on-prem ADFS; certificate renewed and trust re-established.
Container was exceeding its memory limit under real traffic; increased resource limits and added horizontal pod autoscaling.
Idle timeout mismatch between load balancer and backend web server caused connection resets; aligned timeout values.
Backend target group health check interval was too aggressive, marking healthy instances unhealthy under brief latency spikes; tuned thresholds.
Backend target group health check interval was too aggressive, marking healthy instances unhealthy under brief latency spikes; tuned thresholds.

entries.symptom: RDS instance RDS-prod high CPU / slow queries
entries.resolution: Identified a missing index on a frequently-queried table; added index and query plan improved significantly.
One backend instance was silently failing under load; deregistered instance and replaced via auto scaling group.

entries.symptom: RDS instance RDS-prod high CPU / slow queries
entries.resolution: Scaled instance class up one tier to handle sustained load; monitoring for recurrence over next billing cycle.

entries.symptom: RDS instance RDS-prod high CPU / slow queries
entries.resolution: A long-running batch job was locking rows during business hours; rescheduled job to off-peak window.
Idle timeout mismatch between load balancer and backend web server caused connection resets; aligned timeout values.

entries.symptom: RDS instance RDS-db high CPU / slow queries
entries.resolution: Killed a runaway query from a misconfigured reporting tool connection pool; added query timeout limits.

entries.symptom: RDS instance RDS-db high CPU / slow queries
entries.resolution: Scaled instance class up one tier to handle sustained load; monitoring for recurrence over next billing cycle.

entries.symptom: RDS instance RDS-prod high CPU / slow queries
entries.resolution: Killed a runaway query from a misconfigured reporting tool connection pool; added query timeout limits.

Part of the same us-east-1 regional network event; errors stopped once AWS network degradation was mitigated.

entries.resolution: Downstream effect of the VPN-tunnel ISP outage; resolved automatically once the tunnel was restored.
ISP confirmed a fiber cut affecting the primary circuit; tunnel restored once ISP rerouted traffic.
Same ISP fiber cut as the related VPN tunnel outage; phone service restored once ISP rerouted traffic.
